controles.verbatim_source: The Indiana Court of Appeals issued its opinion on February 21, 2023, reversing the IURC's order... / On August 26, 2025, the Indiana Court of Appeals reversed the decision by the IURC concluding that the IURC incorrectly allowed Duke Energy Indiana to collect certain of those coal ash costs from customers. / On January 26, 2026, the Indiana Supreme Court denied Duke Energy Indiana's and the Indiana Office of Attorney General's petitions. controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Nuance possible : le 10-Q ajoute 'There were no material impacts on the results of operations, cash flows or financial position as a result of this ruling', omis par l'ATT.

In April 2026, the EPA proposed to rescind or modify certain aspects of the 2015 CCR Rule, as amended by the 2024 CCR Rule. controles.affirmation: Dossier tarifaire Caroline du Nord : demande de 1,0 Md$ (+15,0%) avec ROE 10,95%, accord du 17 juillet 2026 ramenant a 496 M$ (+7,4%) avec ROE 9,8% et depreciation de 29 M$
controles.verbatim_source: the overall net retail revenue increase was $727 million in Year 1 and $275 million in Year 2, for a combined total of $1.0 billion or 15.0%. The application also requested an ROE of 10.95%... On July 17, 2026... filed a comprehensive settlement with the NCUC... including an ROE of 9.8%... representing a cumulative increase of $496 million, or 7.4%... Duke Energy Carolinas recorded a $29 million impairment charge (10-Q 2026-08-04, Note 4)
controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter que l'accord n'est pas definitif : 'The stipulations are subject to the review and approval of the NCUC.' L'ATT presente la baisse comme acquise.

controles.affirmation: Un endettement qui approche le plafond fixe par les banques : ratio dette sur capitalisation de 63% fin 2025 pour un plafond de covenant de 65% par emprunteur
controles.verbatim_source: Projected 2026 / Actual 2025 / Actual 2024 : Equity 39% 37% 38% ; Debt 61% 63% 62%. ... a covenant requiring the debt-to-total capitalization ratio to not exceed 65% for each borrower, excluding Piedmont, and 70% for Piedmont. (10-K FY2025, Liquidity and Capital Resources)
controles.correction_proposee: Deux defauts : (1) le meme tableau donne un ratio projete 2026 de 61%, en baisse, omis par l'ATT, ce qui contredit le titre 'approche le plafond' ; (2) le covenant s'applique 'for each borrower' (au niveau de chaque emetteur, Piedmont exclu et plafonne a 70%), pas au ratio consolide publie de 63% : la comparaison 63% vs 65% n'est pas homogene. Reformuler : 'Duke publie un ratio dette sur capitalisation consolide de 63% en 2025, projete a 61% en 2026 ; ses lignes de credit imposent par ailleurs un plafond de 65% a chaque emprunteur du groupe (70% pour Piedmont).'
